own_proposal.description: Your own design, derived from the stated intent and the existing code, before comparing with any design in the material.

approaches.description: Approaches that differ in strategy, not small variations of one approach.

id.description: Short unique id such as A1, used to refer to this item later.

strategy.description: The approach in one or two sentences.

tradeoffs.description: What it gains and what it costs.

best_when.description: Conditions under which this approach is the right one.

worst_when.description: Conditions under which this approach goes wrong.

basis.description: traced: followed the code path by reading it; ran: executed a command that shows it; inferred: reasoning without either.

smaller_alternative.description: A much smaller change that gets most of the value; null if there is none.

premise_challenges.description: Premises in the material you doubt. Empty if none.

id.description: Short unique id such as P1, used to refer to this item later.

premise.description: The premise and why you doubt it.

evidence_to_settle.description: What evidence or check would settle it.

basis.description: traced: followed the code path by reading it; ran: executed a command that shows it; inferred: reasoning without either.

would_change_my_mind.description: Evidence that would change your verdict. Empty if none.

need.description: The fact or result you would need to see.

why.description: How it would change your verdict.

questions_for_user.description: Questions only the user can answer, such as preferences, priorities or facts outside the code. Empty if none.

recommended.description: The answer you would pick and why.

caller_challenge.description: Set only when you disagree with a direction the caller has already chosen; otherwise null.

challenge.description: What you think is wrong with the chosen direction.

context_possibly_missing.description: Context the caller may have that you do not, which would make this challenge wrong.

cost_if_wrong.description: What it costs if the caller follows this challenge and you are wrong.

summary.description: 1-3 sentences. No praise, no restating the material.

verdict.description: proceed: the intended route holds up; reconsider: another listed approach looks better; rethink: the goal or its premises need another look.
